title: 第21章 丧家之犬第22章 暗流涌动
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
沈秋鹰视狼顾，战意节节攀升。
沈云负手而立，面上波澜不惊。
“终于轮到我们了，”
沈秋气冲斗牛，声色俱厉道：“三十年河东，三十年河西，今天我会告诉天下谁才是真正的王者。”
沈云有些无语，感觉对方的脑子有点不太正常，莫名其妙的就开始加戏。
“可以开始了吗？”
他懒得理会这种脑残，决定速战速决。
沈秋脸色一沉，目光愈发的阴鸷，对方视若无物的眼神再次刺痛了他的自尊心。
开场火药味十足，观众们立刻打起了精神。
“据说过去沈秋只是沈云的跟班，等到测灵大典后就分道扬镳了。”
“难道又是莫欺少年穷的故事？沈秋这是想证明自我啊。”
“两人都是这一届的绝顶天才，看来会有一场龙争虎斗。”
“…”
在无数期待的目光中，比赛正式拉开了帷幕。
唰！
沈云出手如电，一步之下如同缩地成寸，瞬间出现在沈秋面前。
圆满境界的游云步，火木相融的绝顶灵力，登峰造极的离火剑意。
剑气如同天外而来，爆发出璀璨的光芒，时间都开始停滞了，所有人的动作都在无限放慢。
沈秋的冷笑还挂在脸上，血红色的剑气就已经杀至。
啊！

惨叫声震耳欲聋，过去不到五分之一个呼吸，沈秋就被打成破布口袋，整个人凌空暴起，划出了一道抛物线重重摔到场外。
刺啦！
沈秋地面上贴地滑行，出溜了十多米才刹住。
衣服破烂、鲜血横流，如同一只丧家之犬。
“这…这不是…真的。”
沈秋意识模糊，气若游丝，然而身体上的剧痛比不了心灵的万一。
仅仅一招，他甚至连对方的动作都没有看清，就已经败下阵来，简直和打发阿猫阿狗没什么两样。
沈云俯视着倒在地上的沈秋，平静的目光如同天刀，让人不寒而栗。
‘若非还在沈家，我现在就送你上路。
对方如此强烈的敌意，还三番两次的跳出来搞事，沈云自然不会手下留情。
...
现场瞬间变得鸦雀无声，所有人都目瞪口呆的看着沈云，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。
就连几大长老都忍不住站起身子，三长老有些癫狂的吼道：“练气五层的修为，大成级别的剑气和身法，这怎么可能！”
他从未见过圆满级别的道术，以为沈云的功法境界只是大成之境。
即使如此，对方的表现依旧让他不可置信，甚至以为自己处在梦中。
大长老先是震惊，然后怀疑，最后欣喜若狂，看着沈云的眼神就像看到了传世仙器，迟迟挪不开目光。
沈雷渊紧紧握住把手，面色潮红道：“好天赋！
好修为！
content_en:
Shen Qiuying looked at the wolf, his fighting spirit rising steadily.
Chen Yun stood with his hands behind his back, his face calm.
"Finally it's our turn,"
Shen Qiu angrily fought the bullfight and said with a stern tone: "Thirty years in Hedong, thirty years in Hexi. Today I will tell the world who is the real king."
Chen Yun was a little speechless. He felt that the other party's mind was a little abnormal, so he started to add drama inexplicably.
"Can we start?"
He was too lazy to pay attention to this stupidity and decided to make a quick decision.
Shen Qiu's face darkened, his eyes became more sinister, and the other party's indifferent eyes stung his self-esteem again.
The opening was full of excitement, and the audience immediately cheered up.
"It is said that Shen Qiu was just Shen Yun's follower in the past, and they parted ways after the spirit detection ceremony."
"Is this another story about Mo deceiving young people into poverty? Shen Qiu wants to prove himself."
"Both of them are the top talents of this class. It seems that there will be a battle between dragons and tigers."
“…”
In the eyes of countless expectants, the game officially kicked off.
Uh-huh!
Shen Yun's shot was like lightning, and with one step he seemed to shrink to an inch, appearing in front of Shen Qiu instantly.
The perfect state of Wandering Cloud Steps, the ultimate spiritual power of the fusion of fire and wood, and the ultimate Lihuo Sword Intent.
The sword energy came from the sky, bursting out with bright light. Time began to stand still, and everyone's movements slowed down infinitely.
Shen Qiu's sneer was still on his face, but the blood-red sword energy was already killing him.
ah!
The screams were deafening, and in less than one-fifth of a breath, Shen Qiu was beaten into a rag bag. His whole body shot up in the air, creating a parabola and fell heavily to the outside.
Stab!
Shen Qiu slid close to the ground and slid for more than ten meters before stopping.
The clothes were in tatters and blood was flowing everywhere, like a bereaved dog.
"This... this isn't... real."
Shen Qiu's consciousness was blurred and his breath was as thin as a thread. However, the severe pain in his body was incomparable to the emergency in his mind.
With just one move, he was defeated without even seeing the opponent's movements clearly. It was no different from sending away a cat or a dog.
Shen Yun looked down at Shen Qiu who was lying on the ground, his calm gaze was like a sword from the sky, making people shudder.
‘If you weren’t still in the Shen family, I would send you on your way now.
With the other party showing such strong hostility and jumping out to cause trouble again and again, Shen Yun would naturally not be merciful.
...
The scene instantly became silent. Everyone looked at Shen Yun in stunned silence, and their hearts were filled with turmoil.
Even the elders couldn't help but stand up. The third elder shouted crazily: "With the cultivation of the fifth level of qi training, the sword energy and body skills of the Dacheng level, how is this possible!"
He had never seen a perfect level of Taoism and thought that Shen Yun's level of skills was only the realm of great achievements.
Even so, the other party's performance still made him unbelievable, and he even thought he was in a dream.
The First Elder was shocked at first, then doubtful, and finally ecstatic. He looked at Shen Yun as if he had seen an immortal weapon handed down from ancient times, and could not look away.
Shen Leiyuan held the handle tightly and said with a flushed face: "What a talent!
Good practice!
